page.content:
Rice and fillings rolled in nori and sliced into rounds.

How Maki connects

  • Topic: Sushi — Maki is the rolled form of sushi.
  • Item: Nori — Nori is the wrapper of makizushi.
  • Item: Gunkan-maki — Gunkan-maki is a nori-walled variant of the roll.
  • Item: California roll — The California roll is an inside-out maki adapted in the United States.

What is Maki?

Makizushi is the rolled form — hosomaki, futomaki, uramaki — the shape conveyor belts and grocery trays made global.

Key threads lead to Sushi, Nori, Gunkan-maki and California roll.
